about_item: Soft & Warm Dog Bed: COZY KISS faux fur dog bed are softer and warmer than other ordinary dog beds, specially designed for your pet in winter. Due to vacuum compression, it takes 24-48 hours to return to its original shape. Please note that the inner lining helps to prevent liquid penetration into foam, but the soft plush outer layer itself is not waterproof

Orthopedic Support: COZY KISS's Orthopedic dog sofa is made of high-density egg cage foam, which helps to evenly distribute weight and provides perfect decompression and joint support, reducing the pressure on the joints caused by repeated movement of pets. Note: Do not clean the sponge foam

SOFA BED DESIGN: This bolster dog bed is designed with 3-sided bolsters to offer additional support for your pet’s neck and head, promoting restful sleep. The surrounding sides encourage your dog to snuggle in and enjoy a comfortable night's rest.

Leakproof and Anti-Slip Bottom: The durable foam mattress is wrapped in a waterproof lining, so you don't have to worry about your dog peeing on the stairs. The outer cover can be disassembled for cleaning, the chain cover can be removed within seconds, and it supports machine washing or hand washing. The bottom is made of non slip nylon to minimize the movement of the dog bed

Easy to Assemble or Use: After opening the packaging, please wait for 24-48 hours for it to expand and return to its original shape. No matter how big your dog is, we have dog beds suitable for small, medium, large, and super large breeds. There is a grip on the back for easy carrying and can be used both indoors and outdoors

authors_reviews.title: Love this dog bed!
authors_reviews.text: After trying three different dog beds, I finally found the perfect one—my dog absolutely loves it! It’s incredibly soft, plush, and not super thin like so many other beds we’ve tried, so it actually provides real comfort and support. She settled into it right away and clearly enjoys it.I also love how it looks—it blends seamlessly with the more formal aesthetic of our kitchen, which was important to me. For reference, I have a 90-pound Labrador Retriever, and it holds her size really well without flattening out. Highly recommend if you want something both comfortable and stylish!
authors_reviews.author: phil c.

authors_reviews.title: Amazing!
authors_reviews.text: Wow! This bed is such good quality. It’s way bigger than I thought. The cushion is super thick and sturdy. The tie dye color is super cute. Way worth the money spent! Highly recommended.

authors_reviews.title: Definitely recommend!
authors_reviews.text: Fast delivery, was vacuum packed and already assembled. Sprung up quickly, nice foam thickness that holds firm, no smell at all, beautiful soft gorgeous deep black color fur material, cover looks easy to remove to wash. The pups right away jumped in it rolled around and fell asleep. Shape retention will hold for a long time. I have 3 Poms and they sleep comfortably stretched out with plenty of space between each one. They love their new luxurious bed. Definitely recommend!

authors_reviews.title: Quality bed
authors_reviews.text: Great bed! I ordered an XL for my 50 lb 7 month old GSD puppy. He loves it, supper soft and cushioned and plenty big enough for him to continue to grow into. I wish the boarders on the edges were a little higher because he likes to rest his head on them but it’ll do, he clearly doesn’t seem to mind. Came fast and was an easy unboxing! Says it takes about 24 hours to fully expand but after about 12 it seems to be pretty much done expanding. Definitely recommend this bed!
